name: Fujian Torch Electron Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Torch Electron Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of electronic components, new materials, and related products in China and internationally. The company is involved in the sales in the automotive and new energy sectors; production and sales of machined parts; research and development of thin film capacitors and their supporting equipment production and sales; research and development, manufacturing, and sales of thermal management system.
